HomeAcademic treeProgramme

December 2027 · day TBC · Lisbon

Fifteen collaborator contributions, a one-hour panel discussion, and Rodolphe’s closing response, from 09:00 to 19:40. Each of the sixteen 30-minute talk slots includes a 25-minute talk and 5 minutes for questions. Two 20-minute coffee breaks and a one-hour lunch are included. The running order is provisional; panelists and moderator are to be announced.

Tentative programme · local time. Talk titles and participation are to be confirmed.
